answers.final_answer: F'(3) ≈ −10.976 gal/hr per hour. At t = 3 hours, the rate at which water flows into the reservoir is decreasing by about 10.976 gallons per hour per hour.

answers.brief_reasoning: Set 300 + ∫0^t (100e^{-s/5} − 25)ds = 300. This gives 500(1−e^{-t/5}) = 25t; solving numerically gives t ≈ 19.603.
